title: Application Support Analyst
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role Your Role: As an Application Support Specialist, you will provide operational support for critical business applications and enterprise platforms across Finance, Media, and People domains. You will be responsible for incident resolution, access management, change support, stakeholder engagement, and continuous service improvement while ensuring system stability, compliance, and business continuity. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Business teams, you will help maintain high service standards and enhance the effectiveness of enterprise platforms. What Will You Do: Provide day-to-day support for critical business applications and enterprise platforms, ensuring timely resolution of incidents, service requests, and operational issues. Monitor support queues, investigate and resolve tickets, perform root-cause analysis, and meet agreed service-level objectives and operational commitments. Manage user access lifecycle activities including joiners, movers, leavers, role assignments, approvals, and audit-compliant access administration. Collaborate with Product Owners, Product Managers, Engineering teams, business users, vendors, and technology stakeholders to resolve issues and support business operations. These roles not only offer the chance to inspire and innovate, but also bring with them a sense of pride and accomplishment for having reached the pinnacle of your career in the software industry. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Experience: 5+ years of experience in enterprise application support, business systems support, or application management environments. Strong experience supporting business-critical applications, managing incidents, service requests, access management activities, and operational support processes. Experience working with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, including ticket lifecycle management, escalation handling, and SLA-driven support. Strong understanding of incident management, problem management, change management, root-cause analysis, and production support best practices. Experience supporting user access management, role-based access controls, data maintenance activities, and audit-compliant operational processes. Familiarity with Agile, DevOps, release management, deployment support, testing coordination, and cross-functional delivery teams. Exposure to compliance-driven environments, including SOX controls, audit requirements, governance processes, and change-management controls. Strong communication, stakeholder management, troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, collaboration, and problem-solving capabilities. Preferred Professional and Technical Expertise : Experience supporting enterprise Finance, Planning, ERP, Media, or People platforms within global organizations. Working knowledge of SQL administration, database queries, reporting, and data analysis. Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones and business functions. Exposure to automation, operational analytics, process optimization, and service-improvement initiatives. Relevant certifications in ITIL, Agile, Service Management, Application Support, SQL, or related enterprise technologies are preferred. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. title: Private Credit Analyst - Investor Relations
description: About the job We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Fundraising & Investment Manager with strong expertise in Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), Wealth Management, Investment Advisory, and Portfolio Management. The candidate will be responsible for identifying and acquiring HNI/UHNI investors, driving fundraising activities, evaluating investment opportunities, developing investment strategies, and managing investor relationships. The role requires a combination of strong fundraising capabilities, financial market knowledge, investment analysis, and relationship management skills. The ideal candidate should have an established network of HNI/UHNI investors, practical experience in capital mobilisation, and the ability to identify and recommend suitable investment opportunities. Roles & Responsibilities1. Fundraising & Investor Acquisition Identify, acquire, and develop relationships with HNI/UHNI individuals, family offices, institutional investors, and corporate investors. Drive fundraising initiatives for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) and other investment opportunities. Build and maintain a strong investor database and generate new investment leads. Develop fundraising strategies to achieve assigned capital mobilisation targets. Conduct investor meetings, presentations, and investment discussions to secure commitments. Build relationships with wealth managers, financial advisors, brokers, distributors, and investment partners. Manage the complete fundraising cycle, from lead generation and investor engagement to commitment and onboarding. 2. Investment Research & Evaluation Identify and evaluate investment opportunities across AIFs, PMS, Private Equity, Mutual Funds, Debt Instruments, and structured investment products. Conduct financial analysis, market research, industry assessments, and investment due diligence. Evaluate investment proposals based on financial performance, risk factors, expected returns, liquidity, and market potential. Analyse fund structures, investment strategies, financial statements, and underlying assets. Prepare investment research reports, financial models, proposals, and recommendations. Monitor financial markets, economic developments, and emerging investment opportunities. 3. Investment & Portfolio Management Develop investment strategies and asset allocation recommendations based on investor objectives and risk profiles. Monitor investment portfolios, fund performance, asset allocation, and investment returns. Evaluate portfolio risks, diversification, liquidity, and overall performance. Recommend suitable investment products and portfolio adjustments based on market conditions. Maintain regular communication with investors regarding investment performance and opportunities. Coordinate with fund managers and investment partners to monitor existing investments. 4. Client & Relationship Management Develop and maintain long-term relationships with HNI/UHNI clients and prospective investors. Understand client financial objectives, investment preferences, and risk appetite. Present investment opportunities, fund structures, research findings, and portfolio recommendations. Prepare business presentations, investment proposals, and periodic portfolio reports. Participate in client meetings, investor discussions, and business development activities. Identify cross-selling and additional investment opportunities within the existing client network. 5. Compliance & Documentation Ensure fundraising and investment activities comply with applicable SEBI regulations and internal compliance requirements. Coordinate with legal, compliance, finance, and operations teams for investor onboarding and documentation. Maintain accurate records of investor commitments, fundraising pipelines, and investment activities. Ensure appropriate disclosures and investor communication throughout the investment lifecycle. Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's or master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration. MBA Finance, CFA, CA, or relevant professional qualifications will be preferred. 5–10 years of relevant experience in AIF, Wealth Management, Investment Banking, Portfolio Management, PMS, or Investment Advisory. Strong understanding of AIF Category I, II, and III, PMS, Mutual Funds, Private Equity, Debt Instruments, and alternative investment products. Proven experience in fundraising, capital mobilisation, and HNI/UHNI client acquisition. Established network of HNI/UHNI investors, family offices, or institutional investors. Strong knowledge of investment research, financial analysis, valuation, and portfolio evaluation. Ability to independently generate investment leads and convert prospects into investors. Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship management skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, financial modelling, and investment research tools. NISM certifications or other relevant financial market certifications will be an advantage. * Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Capital mobilisation and fundraising targets achieved. Number of new HNI/UHNI investors acquired. Investor conversion and onboarding ratio. Growth of investor database and business network. Quality of investment research and recommendations. Investment opportunity identification and evaluation. Portfolio monitoring and reporting efficiency. Client retention and relationship development. Preferred Candidate Profile We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked with AIFs, PMS providers, Wealth Management firms, Private Banks, Investment Advisory firms, or Alternative Investment platforms. Candidates with a combination of an established HNI/UHNI investor network, proven fundraising achievements, and hands-on investment analysis experience will be strongly preferred. title: Lab Analyst- MSC Chemistry

That’s because we’re involved in the certification, inspection and validation of major physical assets – from ships and oil rigs to industrial plants and railway rolling stock.

By independently assuring these assets, we give our clients the external recognition they need to demonstrate their products, systems and processes comply with agreed standards of safety and integrity.

Through our business assurance services we help companies manage their systems & risks across a wide range of areas from food safety to energy management.

In everything we do, though, the focal point is always safety. As a global network with operations in 80 different countries, this is what unites us.

title: Lead – Engineering Systems Analyst
description: About Us: Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world. Job Description: Position Summary The Lead– Engineering Systems Analyst will provide technical leadership for the development, administration, standardization, and continuous improvement of the EPLAN and other electrical engineering environment supporting the BW Converting Platform. This role will work at the intersection of Electrical Engineering, Engineering Systems, Automation, and IT , with primary ownership of EPLAN Electric P8, engineering master data, design automation, and integration with downstream business systems. The role will lead initiatives to improve electrical design efficiency, standardization, data quality, engineering automation, and BOM accuracy while ensuring seamless flow of engineering data into ERP, PLM/PDM, manufacturing, and shop-floor systems . Key Responsibilities Lead the administration, development, configuration, and continuous improvement of EPLAN Electric P8 and related modules such as Pro Panel, Preplanning, and Harness proD. Lead EPLAN version upgrades, licensing, user administration, project structures, permissions, revision management, and system governance . Develop and maintain EPLAN parts databases, device master data, manufacturer data, function templates, terminals, connectors, cables, and Data Portal integration . Lead the development of design automation solutions using AI Solutions, EPLAN Cogineer/EEC, macros, scripting, APIs, value sets, and configurable design methodologies. Drive standardization and reuse of electrical circuits, components, macros, and engineering templates to reduce design cycle time. Own and improve the integration of electrical engineering data with ERP, PLM/PDM, BOM, item master, and manufacturing systems . Lead engineering data-quality initiatives covering duplicate parts, obsolete components, incomplete attributes, legacy drawings, and BOM accuracy . Lead migration and standardization of legacy electrical documentation from AutoCAD Electrical, Promise-E, DWG/PDF, or other legacy environments into EPLAN . Provide technical leadership, mentoring, troubleshooting, and training support to electrical designers, controls engineers, and engineering teams . Collaborate with Controls Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Panel Build, Supply Chain, and IT to identify process gaps and implement system improvements. Lead evaluation and implementation of new EPLAN modules, engineering tools, automation solutions, and digital engineering processes . Mandatory Qualifications & Skills Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Industrial Technology, Computer Science, or related field . 12–16 years of overall experience , with strong hands-on experience in electrical engineering systems and EPLAN. Strong hands-on expertise in EPLAN Electric P8 , including administration, configuration, development, and troubleshooting. Strong experience in EPLAN Parts Management, Master Data, Macros, Templates, Project Structures, and Engineering Standards . Experience with EPLAN Pro Panel and 3D panel layout/routing . Strong experience in EPLAN automation , including Cogineer/EEC, scripting, APIs, or similar automation technologies. Strong understanding of electrical schematics, control panels, electrical design processes, BOM structures, and engineering documentation . Experience with AutoCAD Electrical and migration of legacy electrical designs to EPLAN . Experience integrating engineering systems with ERP/PLM/PDM platforms and managing engineering master data. Strong analytical, problem-solving, project leadership, and stakeholder-management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to lead technical discussions and mentor engineering teams . Willingness to travel up to 10-20%, including both local and global BW locations, based on business requirements. Preferred Skills EPLAN administration certification or formal EPLAN training. Experience with EPLAN API, C#, VB, Cogineer/EEC or similar programming/automation technologies. Experience with SAP, Infor XA, Oracle, or other ERP systems in an engineer-to-order/discrete manufacturing environment. Experience with PLM/PDM systems such as Teamcenter, Windchill, Autodesk Vault, or SolidWorks PDM. Strong SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Excel, and Power BI experience. Knowledge of Rockwell Studio 5000 / FactoryTalk and Siemens TIA Portal . Exposure to product configurators, CPQ, engineer-to-order automation, or digital engineering transformation . Leadership Expectations Build EPLAN roadmap, lead EPLAN system-development and engineering digitalization initiatives across the organization. Act as the technical SME for EPLAN and electrical engineering systems . Define and enforce engineering system standards, governance, and best practices. Mentor and guide engineers and designers on EPLAN tools, automation, and engineering-data processes. Work effectively with global engineering and IT teams , including stakeholders across US and international locations. Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on design automation, standardization, engineering productivity, data quality, and manufacturing readiness . At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process. Company: BW Corporate GCC
